name: Gnome
reviewNotes: Walking Speed reduced to 25 feet in the approved comparative Species review; overall balance remains open.
Native Low-Light Vision replaces base 60-foot Darkvision in the approved comparative vision review; a specifically darkness-adapted Ancestry can still grant Darkvision.

Creature type Fey selected in the nine-Species comparative review. Explicit Fey targeting eligibility applies, but monster Outsider/Fey defaults (Hit Dice, vision, senses, competencies, and biological needs) are not automatically granted to playable characters.
No Species-level default Upbringing: General Gnome is inheritance-only; Forest/Rock Gnome Ancestries provide selectable suggestions, and cross-cultural Upbringings remain available.

Fade Away approved as an inherited, shared Gnome characteristic: after taking damage, spend a Reaction to become Invisible until the end of the next turn or until attacking, dealing damage or forcing a saving throw. One use per Short or Long Rest. It does not prevent the triggering damage or grant an ability-score increase.
Provisional biological price +4: shared Gnome 5 to 9, Forest Gnome 14 to 18, Rock Gnome 8 to 12 of the 18-point trial allowance. Rock Gnome remains pending a separate ancestry review.
